name: Fuyu no Himegimi -Winter Princess-
source:
Queen of the Four Seasons controls the world of spirits, but after 300 years she decides to retire. Main heroine Michele is the princess of winter and the most promising candidate as a successor, but disasters start to pile up around her.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-october-2008-volume-7.html]vndbreview[/url]]
